payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_ledger_appends.py::test_finishing_a_run_appends_its_status_to_each_task_it_holds stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The fold applies a `run_finished` only to a row still `RUNNING`, so the row finished twice reads its first status.' applied to saffron/ledger.py as an edit. The claim was '`create_task` appends `run_created` straight after `task_created`. `finish_run` appends one `run_finished` fact, whose payload is exactly the status, to each task its row holds, for a row holding two tasks and for one holding one. A row holding no task gains no fact and still takes the status. A row finished twice appends both facts in order, and a fold keeps the later status.', and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
